Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows. jobs.title: Software Fullstack Engineer Kasse & Support (m/w/d), Werkstudent oder Vollzeit
jobs.description: Software Fullstack Engineer Kasse & Support (m/w/d) Hey du, Freizeitparks, Trampolinhallen und Bäder verkaufen ihre Tickets über ticketbro. Seit Mitte Oktober 2026 läuft bei uns die ticketbro Kasse im Echtbetrieb, mit Stripe Terminal direkt am Tresen. Weitere Betreiber folgen. Für die Kasse suchen wir jemanden, der sie komplett übernimmt: Code, Rollout und die Betreuung der Anwender. Deine Aufgaben Du bist verantwortlich für die ticketbro Kasse, vom Cloud-Backend bis zur Oberfläche am Terminal. Du entwickelst neue Features und behebst Fehler, idealerweise basierend auf deinen eigenen Beobachtungen vor Ort. Du bist Ansprechperson für Betreiber bei technischen Rückfragen, gelegentlich auch am Wochenende. Du richtest die Kasse bei Bedarf direkt beim Betreiber ein und schulst das Team vor Ort. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, um die Kasse im Alltag effizienter und benutzerfreundlicher zu gestalten. Dein Profil Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, gute Englischkenntnisse. Erfahrung mit React oder React Native und TypeScript sowie Grundkenntnisse in Node.js und AWS Lambda (Projekte aus Studium, Praktikum oder eigene Arbeiten sind ausreichend). Du kannst komplexe Technik verständlich erklären und behältst auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf. Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in GraphQL, AWS CDK, Erfahrung mit Payment- oder Kassensystemen sowie ein Führerschein der Klasse B. Du wohnst idealerweise in München, dies ist jedoch keine zwingende Voraussetzung. Was wir bieten Echte Verantwortung für ein Produkt, das bei Betreibern live im Einsatz ist. Anstellung als Werkstudent mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten oder in Vollzeit, unbefristet. Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und bei Vollzeit 30 Tage Urlaub. Hochwertiges Equipment. Flache Hierarchien und direkter Austausch mit dem Management. Büro in München. Bewerbung Schick uns ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben, einen Link zu GitHub oder zu einem Projekt, dein frühestmögliches Startdatum und deine Gehaltsvorstellung (als Werkstudent: Stunden pro Woche). jobs.title: Founding Robotics Engineer Navigation & Autonomy
jobs.description: ABOUT NAXON Naxon Robotics deploys swarms of mobile robots, quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, for security and industrial inspection. The fleet patrols perimeters, detects anomalies and inspects assets as one coordinated system, covering more ground 24/7 , delivering more value and reaching ROI faster than a single robot or a fleet of disconnected ones. Why now : rising threats to critical infrastructure, too few people in security and industry , cheap and reliable hardware and fast moving AI agents. Hardware is ready . Deployment is not. Every new site is still a months-long expert project, so pilots rarely turn into rollouts. We make deployment repeatable, with swarms and an agentic platform that learns from each site. Backed by EWOR, TUM VLABs and a robotics founder who built and exited a drone swarm company . Mentored by unicorn founders and Prof. Johannes Betz (autonomous driving and robotics, TUM). THE ROLE You own the autonomy stack every robot in our fleet runs on: SLAM, localisation and navigation, indoors and outdoors, across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones. You take it from the lab to production at customer sites and keep it robust there. As the fleet grows, you grow the stack into multi robot coordination. This is the core the whole company scales on. You own the stack. The Field Robotics Engineer owns what runs at the customer. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build and own SLAM, localisation, mapping and navigation, indoor and outdoor Select, combine and calibrate sensors: lidar , depth, RGB, thermal, IMU and GNSS Generalise the stack across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones Test and tune on real robots with benchmarks and field data, not only in simulation Define what runs on the robot and what runs in the cloud, including failure and fallback Take the stack to production at customer sites, then extend it to multi robot coordination WHAT YOU BRING Has taken SLAM or an autonomy stack to production at real customers, not only research demos Strong in SLA

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: About Isembard Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics. The role This role sits where MasonOS meets the shop floor. Every new factory in our network adds training, adoption and support work. You will embed with factories and network sites, own their success with MasonOS end to end, ship production code, apply AI to their workflows and build the tools that make each new site easier than the last. You are measured on the support burden falling, not on tickets closed. Put agentic workflows into operational use: reporting, supplier follow-ups and order status. Ship fixes and small features into MasonOS through the same review as every other engineer. Turn patterns from the field into clear, written requirements for the roadmap. What you bring The ability to ship production code with minimal supervision. Full-stack fluency across backend, frontend and integrations. Hands-on experience applying LLMs to real workflows. Clear communication with operators and technical leaders, and the ability to build trust on site. The judgement to decide what matters without waiting for a ticket queue. Useful, not essential: forward-deployed or deployment engineering experience, exposure to manufacturing, CNC, aerospace or defence, or MES or ERP systems. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. Role Summary The Berlin team is looking for a Software Engineer - Connected Vehicle Platform, to design, build, and operate software connecting vehicle systems with infotainment, cloud, and mobile ecosystems. You will bridge low-level communication paths and high-level vehicle interfaces, developing reusable platform capabilities while supporting brand-specific configurations. This role combines software development, systems integration, troubleshooting, and developer enablement. You will help turn vehicle signals and hardware capabilities into dependable services, libraries, gateway behaviors, and APIs that partner engineers can discover, integrate, test, and use successfully. The role is well suited to a developer who enjoys working across system boundaries and taking software from design through production support. This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain communication services, client libraries, gateway and routing components, and deployment configurations; implement message publication and subscription, request/reply interactions, service discovery, signal routing, gateway translation, and reliable failure handling. jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer, Enterprise - German Speaking
jobs.description: From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. jobs.description: About the Position We’re looking for smart and curious individuals to join our growing team and drive our ML work. On our Machine Learning team, you ll build the deep learning models that power our trading strategies, supported by our rapidly growing computing cluster with tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. You’ll train models for the next generation of our deep learning-based trading strategies, and build the fundamental understanding we need to tackle new markets and situations. jobs.description: We are looking for a Research Engineer with robust experience in machine learning and strong mathematical foundations to join our growing ML team and to help drive the direction of our ML platform. jobs.title: Machine Learning Performance Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for an engineer with experience in low-level systems programming and optimisation to join our growing ML team.  Machine learning is a critical pillar of Jane Street s global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction. Your part here is optimising the performance of our models – both training and inference. We care about efficient large-scale training, low-latency inference in real-time systems and high-throughput inference in research. Part of this is improving straightforward CUDA, but the interesting part needs a whole-systems approach, including storage systems, networking and host- and GPU-level considerations. Zooming in, we also want to ensure our platform makes sense even at the lowest level – is all that throughput actually goodput? Does loading that vector from the L2 cache really take that long? If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in.  There’s no fixed set of skills, but here are some of the things we’re looking for: An understanding of modern ML techniques and toolsets The experience and systems knowledge required to debug a training run’s performance end to end Low-level GPU knowledge of PTX, SASS, warps, cooperative groups, Tensor Cores and the memory hierarchy Debugging and optimisation experience using tools like CUDA GDB, NSight Systems, NSight Computesight-systems and nsight-compute Library knowledge of Triton, CUTLASS, CUB, Thrust, cuDNN and cuBLAS Intuition about the latency and throughput characteristics of CUDA graph launch, tensor core arithmetic, warp-level synchronization and asynchronous memory loads Background in Infiniband, RoCE, GPUDirect, PXN, rail optimisation and NVLin

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé , en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan. Votre temps se répartit entre : Analyses RPS (dans le cadre de la PDP) individuels et entretiens, dans le respect de la déontologie des psychologues et du secret professionnel Accompagnement des situations de travail dégradées et participation aux cellules de prévention de la désinsertion professionnelle (PDP) Conception et animation des ateliers collectifs et des formations auprès des salariés et des employeurs Conduite des interventions collectives complexes (crises, réorganisations), contribution au projet Prévenir, tutorat et construction des outils et programmes RPS / QVCT Restitution d'analyses de façon claire et neutre aux entreprises et à l'équipe pluridisciplinaire (IDEST, Médecins, IPRP, Assistants Sociaux) Utilisation et enrichissement de nos outils numériques et d'IA, contribution à la construction du métier chez Prévenir Ce qui change vs. un SPSTI classique : Une équipe pluridisciplinaire à co-construire. Vous ne rejoignez pas un service figé : vous participez à dessiner la place du Psychologue du Travail chez Prévenir, les protocoles de délégation avec les médecins, et les passerelles avec Assistant Sociaux et IPRP Des outils numériques co-construits avec vous. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? SPRiNG est une marque innovante de lessive et de produits d’entretien, créée en 2020 pour proposer une nouvelle manière de consommer tout en réduisant l’effet des produits d’entretien sur la santé et sur l’environnement. Nous sommes en pleine croissance et cherchons un Chef de Projet Supply Chain & Data pour renforcer notre équipe Opérations. Ton rôle Nous recherchons notre futur·e Chef·fe de projet Supply Chain & Data. Ta mission : garantir à nos clients le meilleur niveau de service possible sur l'ensemble de nos produits, en pilotant nos opérations et en t'appuyant sur la data pour les améliorer en continu. Tes missions Opérationnel et amélioration continue Être responsable des process opérationnels qui assurent le bon fonctionnement de notre supply chain Co-animer le process S&OP : construire le prévisionnel des ventes, anticiper les bons niveaux de stock et piloter les flux Suivre et challenger la performance de nos partenaires logistiques Analyser nos données de flux, de stocks et de coûts pour identifier des pistes d'optimisation opérationnelles et stratégiques Analyses stratégiques et gestion de projet Épauler notre Head of Operations sur des analyses opérationnelles et financières Évaluer le potentiel et les risques de chaque opportunité, puis piloter la mise en œuvre des projets retenus Ce que ce stage t'apportera Vivre de l'intérieur le développement d'une start-up en pleine croissance Un rôle très hands-on, en prise directe avec le terrain Des missions variées et un impact direct sur la stratégie et le succès de la marque Le choix de ta ville : rejoins-nous à Paris ou à Barcelone Étudiant·e en Bac+4/5, école d'ingénieur ou de commerce À l'aise avec les chiffres et Excel, esprit d'analyse et grande rigueur Esprit entrepreneurial, goût de l'opérationnel et du terrain Autonome, proactif·ve, positif·ve et débrouillard·e Envie de t'engager dans une entreprise à mission Anglais opérationnel ; l'espagnol est un plus Find more English Speaking

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT
jobs.description: The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT owns the DeepHealth Acute Care CT Suite end to end, with primary accountability for what to build and shared accountability for getting it shipped. DeepHealth is building the Acute Care CT Suite from the ground up to cover detection, care coordination, and reporting for emergency CT, starting with head CT and expanding to chest and abdomen, where minutes saved in stroke, bleeds, and trauma directly affect patient outcomes. The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT shapes the suite from day one: owning the roadmap, translating clinical needs into ML and product work, and driving cross-functional delivery on a subset of the suite from data through customer activation. The role does not write code or own technical software design. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Product Strategy and Roadmap Own the Acute Care CT Suite roadmap and define what to build, defer, or stop based on evidence. Define suite scope across pathology detection modules, software capabilities such as alerting and care coordination, and comprehensive draft reporting. Work with emergency radiologists and neuro/stroke teams to distinguish stated requests from real clinical needs, including time-to-treatment, triage, missed findings, and care coordination. Translate clinical problems into ML work and set model metrics that reflect clinical value, including sensitivity versus false-positive burden. Track the acute care market (including Aidoc, Viz.ai , RapidAI, Nicolab, and peers) and position products with Sales and Marketing. Delivery and Cross-Functional Execution Own delivery end to end on a subset of the Suite, from data to customer activation, including planning, coordination across data, ML, software, QARA, and Support, tracking, and escalation. Run squads for new devices (typically 3 to 9 months), such as ASPECTS detection. Coordinate with QARA on the regulatory impact of each release, including EU MDR and FDA 510(k). Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. Drawing on expertise across RTSL s portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.   Position Purpose The Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health will provide strategic and technical leadership for RTSL s portfolio to reduce preventable maternal deaths and improve sexual and reproductive health outcomes. jobs.description: 1958, Fondasol réalise avec succès sa première mission géotechnique. Aujourd'hui, avec plus de 10 domaines d'expertise, le Groupe Fondasol est la référence en études et ingénierie conseil de la construction. Géotechnique, hydrogéologie, géothermie, sites et sols pollués, géophysique, études de structures…: ses collaborateurs mutualisent leurs compétences pour aider les acteurs de la construction à bâtir durablement leurs projets. Prêt à conjuguer votre leadership, votre fibre commerciale et votre expertise dans un rôle à fort impact? Votre mission : créer, structurer et développer notre présence à Rennes. Véritable entrepreneur au sein du Groupe, vous pilotez la création complète de l’agence : développement commercial, structuration opérationnelle, recrutement progressif et représentation locale. A la fois grand ordonnateur, gestionnaire et optimisateur, vous êtes porté par un fort esprit d’entreprendre , qui contribue activement à la bonne gestion de votre agence. De la phase commerciale au déploiement du projet stratégique et de transformation du Groupe, vous contribuez à la chaine de valeur et à l’image de marque du Groupe Fondasol. Vos principales missions Vous assurez le développement commercial , en proposant l’ensemble de nos expertises et solutions innovantes (Géotechnique, Hydrogéologie, Environnement, Pathologie des Structures, etc.). jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation

Responsibilities & Tasks Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures. Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies. Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls. Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights. Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk. Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers. jobs.description: Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie. Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden. Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com. Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit. Nach einer intensiven internen Einarbeitungsphase (Vormontage und Anlagenmontage) unterstützen Sie unser Team als erfahrener Field Engineer. So schaffen Sie Mehrwert Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben zählen neben selbst durchgeführten mechanischen Montagetätigkeiten, die personelle und fachliche Führung von kleineren bis mittleren Montageteams. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. Read our operating principles to see it in full. jobs.description: Over van der Molen Beveiligingstechniek Van der Molen Beveiligingstechniek is dé plek waar techniek en veiligheid samenkomen. Als groeiend bedrijf in de beveiligingsbranche zijn we op zoek naar collega’s die passie hebben voor hun vak en graag werken in een hecht en betrokken team. Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, te groeien en trots te zijn op de projecten waar je aan werkt. Korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en werken met de nieuwste technieken maken Van der Molen een unieke werkplek. Over de functie Als HR-stagiair(e) werk je nauw samen met onze HR Adviseur en krijg je de kans om praktische ervaring op te doen in verschillende aspecten van HR. Je zult ondersteuning bieden bij dagelijkse HR-taken en projecten en daarmee bijdragen aan de groei en ontwikkeling van Van der Molen Beveiligingstechniek en onze collega's. Je zal alle facetten van HR tegenkomen. Je wordt begeleid door een ervaren professional en krijgt de kans om jouw ideeën en creativiteit in te brengen. Welke werkzaamheden ga je uitvoeren? Meewerken aan projecten op het gebied van scholing & ontwikkeling, onboarding en recruitment; Ontdekken hoe HR en arbeidsmarktcommunicatie elkaar versterken binnen onze organisatie; Actief meedenken en jouw ideeën inbrengen om processen en projecten te verbeteren; De ruimte krijgen om eigen voorstellen uit te werken én daadwerkelijk tot uitvoering te brengen. Wie zoeken we? Een enthousiaste en nieuwsgierige HBO-student HR (of een vergelijkbare richting); Iemand die graag initiatief neemt en niet bang is om ideeën te delen; Iemand die proactief meedenkt en oplossingen aandraagt; Iemand die het leuk vindt om te leren en zich verder te ontwikkelen; Het aantal uren dat je per week beschikbaar bent, stemmen we samen af. Bij Cefetra in Rotterdam hebben we vanaf februari 2027 een stageplek beschikbaar voor een enthousiaste en leergierige IT-student. wie zijn wij? Cefetra Group bestaat uit verschillende handelsbedrijven die actief zijn binnen de agrarische sector en de voedingsingrediëntenindustrie, waaronder toonaangevende merken binnen de ingrediëntenmarkt. Samen hebben we ongeveer 800 medewerkers, verspreid over 39 kantoren in 17 landen wereldwijd. We werken nauw met elkaar samen om onze klanten de best mogelijke service te bieden. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van hoe IT-support binnen een internationale organisatie werkt. jobs.title: Stageplaats bij Pharmapartners
jobs.description: Wil jij als meewerk- of afstudeerstagiair(e) het verschil voor de zorg maken en jezelf ontwikkelen als professional? Jij doet dat bij PharmaPartners. Hoe? Dat lees je hieronder: “Momenteel loop ik stage bij PharmaPartners. Het is mijn eerste stage en het bevalt me ontzettend goed. Ik werk bij de Customer Support afdeling van eHealth aan mijn eigen opdracht, waarmee ook echt iets gedaan wordt. Je krijgt hier veel vertrouwen en vrijheid om aan je eigen opdracht te werken en initiatief te tonen, maar er is altijd iemand die met je meedenkt. jobs.description: Je hebt al een paar jaar ervaring binnen IT, data of architectuur en wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen op het gebied van Artificial Intelligence . Je vindt het interessant om complexe technische vraagstukken te doorgronden, maar krijgt ook energie van het vertalen van technologie naar concrete oplossingen voor een organisatie. Daarnaast weet je complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk uit te leggen aan verschillende stakeholders. Herkenbaar? Dan is deze rol als Medior AI Architect binnen het traineeship Business & IT een mooie volgende stap in jouw carrière. Wat ga je doen als Medior AI Architect? Als Medior AI Architect werk je aan de ontwikkeling en toepassing van AI binnen een grote IT-organisatie. Je helpt mee om AI op een veilige, schaalbare en toekomstbestendige manier toe te passen en zorgt dat nieuwe AI-oplossingen goed aansluiten op de bestaande IT- en dataomgeving. Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van AI, data, architectuur en strategie . Daarbij werk je samen met verschillende teams en stakeholders en vertaal je organisatiedoelen naar technische mogelijkheden. Je krijgt te maken met onderwerpen als generative AI, machine learning, data governance, security en integratie. jobs.title: Teamleider HR Operations
jobs.description: Bij HeinenoordZicht Groep bouwen we aan één nieuwe organisatie. Daarbij vernieuwen en professionaliseren we onze HR‑dienstverlening: slimmer, efficiënter en meer data-gedreven. Daarom zoeken we een Teamleider HR Operations . In deze nieuwe rol zorg jij dat de HR‑basis staat als een huis: betrouwbare processen, goed ingerichte systemen, heldere managementinformatie en een team dat de organisatie dagelijks ondersteunt met soepele HR‑dienstverlening. Jouw rol Als Teamleider HR Operations ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen strategisch HR-beleid en de dagelijkse uitvoering. Met jouw visie en daadkracht help je het team groeien en til je onze HR‑dienstverlening naar een hoger niveau. In deze rol geef je leiding aan een deskundig HR Operations‑team van zeven HR‑specialisten, actief op het gebied van HR‑services en salarisverwerking. Samen zorgen jullie voor betrouwbare, hoogwaardige en toekomstbestendige HR‑dienstverlening en lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de slagkracht van HR binnen de organisatie. Het HR Operations team werkt deels vanuit Oud-Beijerland en deels vanuit Den Bosch. We hechten veel waarde aan samenwerking en verbinding. Daarom werken jullie twee keer per week samen op locatie in Oud-Beijerland en vinden ook op de locatie Den Bosch een dag per week verschillende overleggen plaats. Een greep uit je werkzaamheden: Je geeft leiding aan het HR Operations-team en stimuleert eigenaarschap, vakmanschap en samenwerking binnen het team. Je zorgt dat HR-processen rondom in-, door- en uitstroom soepel en uniform verlopen, en optimaliseert deze waar nodig. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheer en de verdere ontwikkeling van AFAS, inclusief workflows, autorisaties, selfservice en datakwaliteit. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en tijdigheid van HR-mutaties richting salarisadministratie en stuurt op een correcte payroll control in samenwerking met Finance. jobs.title: Managing Director, Cozy Heaven
jobs.description: Lead an established brand and take responsibility for its next chapter. Cozy Heaven is a German premium bedding brand and part of Everest. As Managing Director, you will lead a small team and take responsibility for the complete business, bringing product, customer experience, commercial performance and operations together. This is a hands-on leadership role, combining long-term direction with close involvement in day-to-day execution. What you will build Own the company P&L, operating plan and quality of growth. jobs.description: Über uns book-n-drive ist einer der führenden regionalen Carsharing-Anbieter. Wir ermöglichen Menschen, flexibel auf ein Auto zuzugreifen, ohne selbst eines besitzen zu müssen. Gemeinsam mit Bus, Bahn und Fahrrad schaffen wir eine praktische Alternative zum eigenen Auto. Wir möchten nicht einfach mehr Menschen zum Autofahren bewegen. Wir möchten Menschen dabei unterstützen, ihren tatsächlichen Mobilitätsbedarf flexibel, wirtschaftlich und möglichst ohne eigenes Auto zu organisieren. Dafür entwickeln wir unseren Kundenservice weiter: Neben der zuverlässigen Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen wollen wir unsere Kunden künftig stärker persönlich begleiten, beraten und langfristig betreuen. Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir eine kommunikative, eigenständige Persönlichkeit, die gerne auf Menschen zugeht, ihre Bedürfnisse versteht und gemeinsam mit ihnen passende Lösungen findet. Deine Aufgaben Kunden aktiv betreuen: Du gehst gezielt auf Kunden zu und unterstützt sie dabei, book-n-drive optimal für ihren Mobilitätsbedarf zu nutzen. Neukunden begleiten: Du hilfst neuen Kunden beim Einstieg, beantwortest Fragen und sorgst dafür, dass sie ihre ersten Erfahrungen mit book-n-drive erfolgreich meistern. Mobilitätsbedarf verstehen: Du findest im Gespräch heraus, wann und wofür Kunden ein Auto benötigen, welche Alternativen sie nutzen und welche Hindernisse einer regelmäßigen Nutzung entgegenstehen. Individuelle Lösungen finden: Du erklärst passende Fahrzeuge, Stationen, Tarife und Angebote und zeigst, wie sich Carsharing sinnvoll mit Bus, Bahn und Fahrrad kombinieren lässt. Kundenbeziehungen entwickeln: Du betreust Kunden auch nach ihren ersten Fahrten, gehst auf Schwierigkeiten ein und hilfst ihnen, book-n-drive dauerhaft und bedarfsgerecht in ihren Alltag zu integrieren. Kundenservice unterstützen: Du bearbeitest auch telefonische und schriftliche Kundenanfragen zu Registrierung, Buchung und Fahrzeugnutzung und unterstützt das Team bei Bedarf im laufenden Service. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Enjoy solving complex backend challenges, working with distributed systems, and having a real say in technical decisions? Join our Email Security team as a Senior Backend Engineer and help build, improve, and evolve the backend services powering our cybersecurity products. You'll work in a technically demanding environment where performance, scalability, reliability, and security matter. From improving existing systems to designing new services, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful engineering challenges and influence how our products evolve. Full-time hybrid in Hanover. Your Job Take technical ownership of existing and new applications or services within our cybersecurity product ecosystem. Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable, and maintainable software solutions. Lead and contribute to architectural decisions and help shape long-term technical direction. Collaborate cross-functionally with other developers, product management, system engineers, UX/UI, and QA teams to deliver end-to-end solutions. Mentor and support Junior Developers, fostering best practices and continuous improvement. Work across multiple products, contributing to new features, improvements, and long-term maintenance. Your Profile 5+ years of professional experience as a Software Developer, with a strong focus on backend development. Strong Python experience, experience with Java or Go is a plus. Experience designing, operating, and optimizing relational or non-relational databases. Experience with Elasticsearch, SQL databases, or Redis is especially relevant. Comfortable working in UNIX-based environments, especially Linux . Strong experience building and maintaining scalable, high-quality software within complex, distributed systems. Strong analytical skills, structured thinking, and a high sense of ownership. Fluent in spoken and written English. Nice-to-haves Experience in any of the following areas would be useful, but you don't need to tick every box.

jobs.title: Environment Artist
jobs.description: About Techtive Games Techtive Games is a Germany-based video game developer creating Ardem , an open-world survival game. Built by former modding veterans, the studio combines AA-level ambition with an independent mindset to push development practices forward and build immersive worlds built to be played, modified, and expanded. We're looking for an Environment Artist to join our team as we move into full production on our debut game Ardem, an open world survival game developed in Unreal Engine 5. In this role, your focus is asset production, with a strong emphasis on architecture and modularity. Our world artists build Ardem's world —> you create what they build it with: modular architecture kits, bespoke landmark structures, and the environmental assets that make the world feel believable and lived-in. You won't be doing level design yourself, but you need the instincts of someone who could — assets only work if they're made with world-building in mind. At Techtive, we believe in a creative workflow where everyone contributes to the final look and feel of the world. It's a team effort: you'll work closely with World Art, Tech Art, and 3D Art, using cutting-edge UE5 tech to push visuals to new heights. One thing we care about a lot: we're hiring from our community. We want people who actually play survival games — not as market research, but because it's your genre. Sie leiten daraus Empfehlungen für die Ausgestaltung unserer Marktangebote ab und entwickeln Tools zur systematischen Bewertung der Versorgungssicherheit in Deutschland. Sie entwickeln und leiten strategische Projekte zur Nutzung unsere Terminalstandorte. jobs.description: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join: The Threat Detection and Response team (TDR) at Airbnb is focused on automating security detection, responding to security incidents, and working with partner teams to build capabilities that support the incident lifecycle. This is the front-line team that detects, investigates, and responds to internal & external security threats and malicious activity. This is a key role to help define and execute our vision for threat detection and incident response capabilities and process while mentoring other team members. As a senior engineer on the team, you will have direct impact building, optimizing, and growing securing capabilities as you help deliver world-class threat detection and incident response. The Difference You Will Make: You will be a key member of our growing Threat Detection & Response (TDR) team. You will get an opportunity to define and execute on novel approaches to detecting, containing and mitigating threats and incidents. You will partner with cross-functional partners across the company to improve the overall security of Airbnb driven by learnings and root cause analysis of investigations and incidents resulting in removal of entire classes of problems. A Typical Day:  Perform investigations of security incidents using your knowledge of digital forensics and data analytics. Use your coding, data analytics and investigation skills to hunt, detect and respond to threats. jobs.description: Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue. We re building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us. Senior SRE - Networks Fastly’s Technical Operations (TechOps) team is responsible for building & operating the infrastructure that powers the Fastly Edge Cloud Platform. We oversee an extensive global network that spans 6 continents with over 100 points of presence and 578 Tbps of connected capacity.  Our platform serves a significant portion of the content delivered to internet consumers across the planet, with customers ranging from online media streaming services to e-commerce, to open source projects, nonprofits and more. We take this responsibility seriously! We’re looking for an experienced SRE with strong focus on Networks, SRE principals and knowledge of the internet who can bring engineering best practices, operational rigour, and automation skills to help craft the future of Fastly’s network and directly contribute to making the internet better. What You ll Do: Build, operate, and maintain the continually growing global network footprint of Fastly’s Edge Cloud Platform. Response to significant traffic incidents and lead network incidents, resolving edge cases and failure scenarios with your expertise in IP routing, particularly BGP. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. jobs.title: (Senior) Marketing & Communications Manager, UK
jobs.description: Change.org is looking for a (Senior) Marketing & Communications Manager to lead our organisation and team in the UK as Market Lead and be the public face of Change.org in the country. Your job is to make the country notice. You will create big, viral campaigns, online and offline, that put the everyday people who start petitions on Change.org at the centre of the national conversation. You will lead a small, high-performing team, open doors through deep networks across UK politics, civil society, civic tech, newsrooms, broadcasters, and use AI to move faster than anyone else in the news cycle. We'd welcome ambitious and entrepreneurial Communications Manager level candidates with leadership presence, who are ready to step up into a team leadership role. Change.org is the world's largest petition platform, used by more than 100 million people every year to take part in civic life and democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy is at an all-time high, we are investing heavily in AI to build the most powerful tools in the world to give people a voice, while bringing people across the political spectrum together around shared solutions. What you will achieve Create awareness spikes . Regularly turn petitions from Change.org petition starters into national moments that people talk about, through viral campaigns that combine top-tier media, social media, video, creators and offline actions such as stunts, petition handovers and public events. Turn those moments into measurable growth for Change.org in the UK, such as new petition starters, signers and supporters. At a Senior Manager level, own the UK team's goals and report on how campaigns contribute to Change.org 's wider growth targets. Put petition starters in the spotlight. Find the strongest stories and the most credible, unexpected voices, and give them the visibility they need to win. Coach them on strategy, find the route to victory, and help them build the pressure that gets decision makers to act.

jobs.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
jobs.description: What Quadrants is Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research. The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton. It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public. The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast. The role You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap. Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further. It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows. The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is s

jobs.title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
jobs.description: What we're building Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future. Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI . One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available ( paper ). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact ( paper ) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise. Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright. This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy . Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute. The role You push the physics of Genesis-World forward.

jobs.title: GPU Engineer
jobs.description: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results. We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually. This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it. Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai .
